interpretation: Bo1 series end with smaller margin than multi-map series (mean 1.00 vs 1.58, p = 0.00e+00, d = 2.54), a real format effect.

Series margin differs across tiers (F = 9.4, p = 8.51e-05, eta-sq = 0.002); the Tukey table shows which pairs differ, with tier3 the noisiest (forfeits), though variance-homogeneity is assumed, not tested (Levene skipped, car not installed).

Sweeps happen in 56.9% of decided multi-map series (n = 7900), which differs significantly from 50% (p = 7.09e-35); Wald CI [0.558, 0.580] vs prop.test's Wilson interval differ because Wilson centers differently near p far from 0.5.
